rows.section: Salary tax (porez na zarade)
rows.label: Non-taxable amount (neoporezivi iznos), full-time employee
rows.basis: Gross monthly salary of a full-time employee (withheld by the employer)
rows.note: One flat rate of 10% on the salary above the monthly non-taxable amount of RSD 34,221 in 2026 (RSD 37,369 from 1 January 2027); part-time workers get a proportional amount. Higher incomes also pay the annual income tax, which is assessed per individual with a deduction for each dependent family member.
rows.source_title: Poreska uprava: Закон о порезу на доходак грађана, consolidated to 80/26 (PDF of 18 September 2026), arts. 15a and 16

rows.section: Employer levies and hiring reliefs
rows.label: Quota for employees with disabilities
rows.value: 20 to 49 employees: one person with a disability; 50 or more: at least two, plus one for each further started 50 employees (new employers are exempt for 24 months)
rows.note: Reliefs are refunds, stored as notes; law 80/26 extends them to 2028 wages.

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Duty-free threshold for non-commercial consignments
rows.value: EUR 50 actual value (alcohol, perfume and tobacco excluded); gifts between private persons up to EUR 70 are free of duty and VAT
rows.note: Customs Law and the Decree on customs reliefs; Serbia is outside the EU customs union.
rows.source_title: Uprava carina: Пошиљке, questions and answers (last updated 2026-05-14); Уредба о царинским повластицама

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Consignments above the threshold
rows.value: 10% single duty rate plus 20% VAT up to EUR 3,000; above that, the regular procedure at the Customs Tariff rates
rows.note: Customs Law and the Decree on customs reliefs; Serbia is outside the EU customs union.
rows.source_title: Uprava carina: Пошиљке, questions and answers (last updated 2026-05-14); Уредба о царинским повластицама

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Duty basis
rows.value: Customs value: the transaction value plus transport, insurance and handling up to entry into Serbia (CIF basis); postage is not counted for consignments up to EUR 50
rows.note: Customs Law and the Decree on customs reliefs; Serbia is outside the EU customs union.
rows.source_title: Uprava carina: Пошиљке, questions and answers (last updated 2026-05-14); Уредба о царинским повластицама

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Import VAT
rows.note: 10% for goods on the reduced list; due on every consignment whatever its value
rows.source_title: Poreska uprava: Закон о порезу на додату вредност (consolidated text to 80/26), arts. 19, 23, 26 and 59; Uprava carina: Пошиљке (2026-05-14)

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Collection scheme for low-value imports
rows.value: No IOSS-type scheme: Customs calculates duty and VAT from electronic pre-arrival data and the recipient pays on delivery
rows.note: Customs Law and the Decree on customs reliefs; Serbia is outside the EU customs union.
rows.source_title: Poreska uprava: Закон о порезу на додату вредност (consolidated text to 80/26), arts. 19, 23, 26 and 59; Uprava carina: Пошиљке (2026-05-14)

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Customs fees
rows.value: No fee for customs control during regular hours; republic administrative fees only for special services. The post office charges for representation and storage under its own tariff, not set by law
rows.note: Customs Law and the Decree on customs reliefs; Serbia is outside the EU customs union.
rows.source_title: Uprava carina: Услуге на које се плаћају таксе (last updated 2026-07-01); Царински закон art. 38

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Fee for a customs expert opinion, individuals
rows.note: Customs Law and the Decree on customs reliefs; Serbia is outside the EU customs union.
rows.source_title: Uprava carina: Услуге на које се плаћају таксе (last updated 2026-07-01); Царински закон art. 38

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Fee for a customs expert opinion, companies
rows.note: Customs Law and the Decree on customs reliefs; Serbia is outside the EU customs union.
rows.source_title: Uprava carina: Услуге на које се плаћају таксе (last updated 2026-07-01); Царински закон art. 38

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Travellers: duty-free goods (domestic travellers)
rows.value: Up to EUR 100 per traveller, not for resale, besides personal luggage; no separate air or land allowance is published (foreign travellers: personal luggage only)
rows.note: Customs Law and the Decree on customs reliefs; Serbia is outside the EU customs union.
rows.source_title: Uprava carina: Путнички промет (last updated 2026-01-27); Уредба о царинским повластицама art. 3

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Travellers: tobacco
rows.value: 50 cigarettes, or 25 cigarillos, or 10 cigars, or 50 g of tobacco
rows.note: Customs Law and the Decree on customs reliefs; Serbia is outside the EU customs union.
rows.source_title: Uprava carina: Путнички промет (last updated 2026-01-27); Уредба о царинским повластицама art. 3

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Travellers: alcohol
rows.value: 1 litre of spirits or 1 litre of sparkling or liqueur wine, and 1 litre of other wine
rows.note: Customs Law and the Decree on customs reliefs; Serbia is outside the EU customs union.
rows.source_title: Uprava carina: Путнички промет (last updated 2026-01-27); Уредба о царинским повластицама art. 3

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Travellers: perfume
rows.value: One perfume up to 50 ml and one toilet water up to 25 ml
rows.note: Customs Law and the Decree on customs reliefs; Serbia is outside the EU customs union.
rows.source_title: Uprava carina: Путнички промет (last updated 2026-01-27); Уредба о царинским повластицама art. 3

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Travellers: fuel
rows.value: Fuel in the vehicle's factory-fitted tanks is duty-free (no quantity limit stated)
rows.note: Customs Law and the Decree on customs reliefs; Serbia is outside the EU customs union.
rows.source_title: Uprava carina: Путнички промет (last updated 2026-01-27); Уредба о царинским повластицама art. 3

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Travellers: goods above the allowance
rows.value: 10% duty on the estimated value plus 20% VAT, up to EUR 3,000
rows.note: Customs Law and the Decree on customs reliefs; Serbia is outside the EU customs union.
rows.source_title: Uprava carina: Путнички промет (last updated 2026-01-27); Уредба о царинским повластицама art. 3

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Cash declaration
rows.value: Cash and bearer instruments of EUR 10,000 or more (in dinars or foreign currency) must be declared to Customs on entry and exit
rows.note: Customs Law and the Decree on customs reliefs; Serbia is outside the EU customs union.
rows.source_title: Uprava carina: Пријава преноса средстава преко границе, опште одредбе (last updated 2026-03-18); Закон о спречавању прања новца и финансирања тероризма art. 86

rows.section: Customs, import VAT and travel allowances
rows.label: Official tariff
rows.value: Uprava carina TARIC in the ITMS application: https://itms.carina.rs (free, no login; nomenclature, measures and an indicative duty calculator)
rows.note: Customs Law and the Decree on customs reliefs; Serbia is outside the EU customs union.
rows.source_title: Uprava carina: TARIC (ITMS) (last updated 2026-11-03)

rows.section: Complete list of taxes and charges
rows.label: Salary tax and personal income tax (porez na dohodak građana) [national]
rows.value: 10% on salaries and self-employment income; 15% capital income and gains; 20% other income; annual tax 10% / 15%. Paid by individuals (salary tax withheld by employers). Zakon o porezu na dohodak građana
rows.note: Each row has its own source.

rows.label: Mandatory social insurance contributions (doprinosi za obavezno socijalno osiguranje) [national]
rows.value: pension 24%, health 10.3%, unemployment 0.75% (employees 19.9%, employers 15.15%). Paid by employees, employers and the self-employed. Zakon o doprinosima za obavezno socijalno osiguranje art. 44
rows.note: Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: Poreska uprava: Закон о доприносима за обавезно социјално осигурање, consolidated text to 80/26 (PDF of 18 September 2026), arts. 9 and 44

rows.section: Complete list of taxes and charges
rows.label: Corporate income tax (porez na dobit pravnih lica) [national]
rows.value: 15%; withholding 20% (25% preferential jurisdictions) on payments to non-residents. Paid by companies. Zakon o porezu na dobit pravnih lica arts. 39–40
rows.note: Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: Poreska uprava: Закон о порезу на добит правних лица (consolidated to 80/26, PDF of 18 September 2026), arts. 39–40

rows.section: Complete list of taxes and charges
rows.label: Value added tax (porez na dodatu vrednost) [national]
rows.value: 20%; 10%. Paid by registered businesses and importers. Zakon o porezu na dodatu vrednost art. 23
rows.note: Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: Poreska uprava: Опште о ПДВ-у; Закон о порезу на додату вредност arts. 23 and 33 (PURS consolidated text to 80/26)

rows.section: Complete list of taxes and charges
rows.label: Excise duties (akcize) [national]
rows.value: specific amounts on fuel, alcohol, tobacco and coffee; 7.5% on electricity. Paid by producers and importers. Zakon o akcizama
rows.note: Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: Poreska uprava: Усклађени динарски износи акциза (Government, 6 February 2026, from 15 February 2026); Zakon o akcizama

rows.section: Complete list of taxes and charges
rows.label: Tax on non-life insurance premiums (porez na premije neživotnih osiguranja) [national]
rows.value: 5%. Paid by insurers. Zakon o porezu na premije neživotnih osiguranja art. 5
rows.note: Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: Paragraf (portal to the official text): Zakon o porezu na premije neživotnih osiguranja (Sl. glasnik RS 135/2004 i 68/2014 - dr. zakon), art. 5

rows.section: Complete list of taxes and charges
rows.label: Greenhouse-gas emissions tax (porez na emisije gasova sa efektom staklene bašte) [national]
rows.value: EUR 4 per tonne of CO2 above reference emissions. Paid by operators of permitted industrial and power installations. Law of 2025, applies from 1 January 2026
rows.note: Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: Poreska uprava: Закон о порезу на емисије гасова са ефектом стаклене баште (Sl. glasnik RS 109/25, 80/26), consolidated text of 18 September 2026, arts. 3, 5 and 11

rows.section: Complete list of taxes and charges
rows.label: Absolute rights transfer tax (porez na prenos apsolutnih prava) [national]
rows.value: 2.5%. Paid by sellers of real estate and rights; buyers of used vehicles. Zakon o porezima na imovinu art. 30 (revenue to municipalities)
rows.note: Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: Paragraf (portal to the official text): Zakon o porezima na imovinu, consolidated to 94/2024, arts. 23 to 31b

rows.section: Complete list of taxes and charges
rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax (porez na nasleđe i poklon) [national]
rows.value: 0%, 1.5% or 2.5% by order of succession. Paid by heirs and recipients. Zakon o porezima na imovinu art. 19 (revenue to municipalities)
rows.note: Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: Paragraf (portal to the official text): Zakon o porezima na imovinu, consolidated to 94/2024, arts. 14 to 21; Poreska uprava notice of 24 November 2025

rows.section: Complete list of taxes and charges
rows.label: Taxes on the use of motor vehicles, vessels, aircraft and firearms (porezi na upotrebu, držanje i nošenje dobara) [national]
rows.value: fixed annual amounts by engine size (cars RSD 1,910 to 349,560). Paid by owners, at registration. Zakon o porezima na upotrebu, držanje i nošenje dobara
rows.note: Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: Paragraf (portal to the official text): Zakon o porezima na upotrebu, držanje i nošenje dobara, consolidated with 118/2025 - usklađeni din. izn., arts. 2 to 6

rows.section: Complete list of taxes and charges
rows.label: Customs duty (carina) [national]
rows.value: Customs Tariff rates; 10% single rate on non-commercial consignments and travellers' goods up to EUR 3,000. Paid by importers and travellers. Carinski zakon
rows.note: Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: Uprava carina: Пошиљке, questions and answers (last updated 2026-05-14); Уредба о царинским повластицама

rows.section: Complete list of taxes and charges
rows.label: Republic administrative fees (republičke administrativne takse) [national]
rows.value: fixed amounts per document or service, e.g. RSD 430 per request, RSD 860 per tax certificate. Paid by applicants to state bodies. Zakon o republičkim administrativnim taksama, amounts from 1 July 2026
rows.note: Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: Poreska uprava: Обавештење о измењеним износима републичке административне таксе (1 July 2026)

rows.section: Complete list of taxes and charges
rows.label: Public media service fee (taksa za javni medijski servis) [national]
rows.value: RSD 349 a month in 2026. Paid by users of electricity meters, on the electricity bill. Zakon o javnim medijskim servisima arts. 37–41
rows.note: Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: RTS (public media service): Taksa za javni medijski servis i uslovi oslobađanja; Zakon o javnim medijskim servisima arts. 37 to 41

rows.section: Complete list of taxes and charges
rows.label: Payment in lieu of employing persons with disabilities [national]
rows.value: 50% of the average salary per person not employed. Paid by employers with 20 or more employees below the quota. Zakon o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba sa invaliditetom art. 26
rows.note: Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: Paragraf (portal to the official text): Zakon o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba sa invaliditetom (Sl. glasnik RS 36/2009, 32/2013 i 14/2022 - dr. zakon), arts. 24 to 28

rows.section: Complete list of taxes and charges
rows.label: Property tax (porez na imovinu) [local]
rows.value: up to 0.4% (bookkeepers), 0.3% (land), 0.4% to 2% progressive for other owners. Paid by owners of real estate. Zakon o porezima na imovinu art. 11; rates set by each municipality
rows.note: Each row has its own source.
rows.source_title: Paragraf (portal to the official text): Zakon o porezima na imovinu, consolidated to Sl. glasnik RS 94/2024, arts. 5, 6, 11 and 13; Poreska uprava notice of 12 November 2025

rows.section: Complete list of taxes and charges

rows.source_title: Paragraf (portal to the official text): Zakon o ugostiteljstvu (Sl. glasnik RS 17/2019 and amendments), arts. 70 to 76

rows.source_title: Paragraf (portal to the official text): Zakon o finansiranju lokalne samouprave (to 115/2025), arts. 6, 15–15v

rows.source_title: Paragraf (portal to the official text): Zakon o finansiranju lokalne samouprave (to 115/2025), arts. 6, 15–15v

rows.section: Complete list of taxes and charges
rows.label: Local administrative fees (lokalne administrativne takse) [local]

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Entrepreneurs on actual income
rows.value: 10% income tax on taxable profit, plus contributions of 24% pension, 10.3% health and 0.75% unemployment (at least on the lowest base)
rows.note: No digital-nomad permit; the inbound regime is the 70% relief for newly settled employees.
rows.source_title: Poreska uprava: Закон о доприносима за обавезно социјално осигурање arts. 9, 22, 36 and 44; Закон о порезу на доходак грађана arts. 33, 33a and 38 (consolidated texts to 80/26)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Flat-rate entrepreneurs (paušal)
rows.value: Tax and contributions on a flat-rate income set by the Tax Administration; for turnover up to RSD 6,000,000 a year, not VAT-registered, outside the excluded activities
rows.note: No digital-nomad permit; the inbound regime is the 70% relief for newly settled employees.
rows.source_title: Poreska uprava: Закон о порезу на доходак грађана arts. 40–41; Уредба о паушалном опорезивању (to 115/25)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Freelancers paid from abroad (no withholding payer)
rows.value: Quarterly self-assessment: model A, 20% after RSD 110,647 of costs; model B, 10% after RSD 66,733 plus 34% of gross income; pension and health contributions on top
rows.note: No digital-nomad permit; the inbound regime is the 70% relief for newly settled employees.
rows.source_title: Poreska uprava: Усклађени динарски неопорезиви износи (Government, 22 January 2026, from 1 February 2026); ZPDG arts. 85–86

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: VAT registration threshold (turnover in 12 months)
rows.note: No digital-nomad permit; the inbound regime is the 70% relief for newly settled employees.
rows.source_title: Poreska uprava: Опште о ПДВ-у; Закон о порезу на додату вредност arts. 23 and 33 (PURS consolidated text to 80/26)

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Digital-nomad or remote-work visa
rows.value: None: the grounds for temporary residence (employment, education, research, investor, Serbian origin, start-up, talent, property, family, independent stay and others) include no digital-nomad ground; the Law on Foreigners allows the Government to create one, but no act has been adopted
rows.note: No digital-nomad permit; the inbound regime is the 70% relief for newly settled employees.
rows.source_title: Government of Serbia, Welcome to Serbia (foreigners' portal): Потребна вам је дозвола за привремени боравак (last updated 12.11.2026); Zakon o strancima art. 40

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Where residence permits are issued
rows.value: Ministry of the Interior, Police Directorate (its units for the movement and stay of foreigners)
rows.note: No digital-nomad permit; the inbound regime is the 70% relief for newly settled employees.
rows.source_title: Government of Serbia, Welcome to Serbia (foreigners' portal): Потребна вам је дозвола за привремени боравак (last updated 12.11.2026); Zakon o strancima art. 40

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Foreigners working remotely in Serbia for foreign payers
rows.value: Must self-assess and pay income tax and pension and health contributions quarterly on income for work done in Serbia, even as non-residents (Government guidance)
rows.note: No digital-nomad permit; the inbound regime is the 70% relief for newly settled employees.
rows.source_title: Government of Serbia, Welcome to Serbia (foreigners' portal): Потребна вам је дозвола за привремени боравак (last updated 12.11.2026); Zakon o strancima art. 40

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Tax residence of a foreigner living in Serbia
rows.value: Resident with domicile or the centre of business and vital interests in Serbia, or after 183 days in a 12-month period; foreign-source income is not exempt: residents are taxed on income earned in Serbia and abroad (ZPDG art. 7)
rows.note: No digital-nomad permit; the inbound regime is the 70% relief for newly settled employees.
rows.source_title: Poreska uprava: Закон о порезу на доходак грађана, consolidated text to 80/26, arts. 7, 8 and 16

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Inbound regime: qualified newly settled employees
rows.value: Salary tax base and contribution base reduced by 70% for 5 years from the employment contract
rows.note: No digital-nomad permit; the inbound regime is the 70% relief for newly settled employees.
rows.source_title: Poreska uprava: Закон о порезу на доходак грађана, consolidated to 80/26, arts. 12a and 15v; PIO Fund 2026 amounts

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Newly settled employees: who qualifies
rows.value: Not mainly resident in Serbia in the 24 months before the contract, or under 40 and abroad for study or training in the previous 12 months; an indefinite contract with a qualified employer; must become tax resident (centre of interests)
rows.note: No digital-nomad permit; the inbound regime is the 70% relief for newly settled employees.
rows.source_title: Poreska uprava: Закон о порезу на доходак грађана, consolidated to 80/26, arts. 12a and 15v; PIO Fund 2026 amounts

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Newly settled employees: monthly salary must exceed (three average monthly salaries, 2026)
rows.note: No digital-nomad permit; the inbound regime is the 70% relief for newly settled employees.
rows.source_title: Poreska uprava: Закон о порезу на доходак грађана, consolidated to 80/26, arts. 12a and 15v; PIO Fund 2026 amounts

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Newly settled employees under 40: monthly salary must exceed (two average monthly salaries, 2026)
rows.note: No digital-nomad permit; the inbound regime is the 70% relief for newly settled employees.
rows.source_title: Poreska uprava: Закон о порезу на доходак грађана, consolidated to 80/26, arts. 12a and 15v; PIO Fund 2026 amounts

rows.section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
rows.label: Non-residents: salary tax on employment income for work done in Serbia (same rules as residents)
rows.note: with the same non-taxable amount; Serbian income counts for the annual tax

rows.value: Agreements with 35 countries; foreigners employed in Serbia by foreign employers pay contributions unless an agreement provides otherwise
rows.note: No digital-nomad permit; the inbound regime is the 70% relief for newly settled employees.
